scope: Only initial main source128-131 F1 counting-tool correction. No source draft, source pixel, crop, source science, F2/F3, previously passed source gate or figure evidence changed or rereviewed.

changedFiles.change: Add optional keyword-only top_margin_px to line_bands. Omission/None retains the old default. Explicit values must be built-in integers, not booleans, from1 through floor(page_height/10). Mask rows[:top_margin_px] only on the existing counting copy without changing source coordinates or extraction pixels.

Add _counting_line_bands for page counting metadata and call it only in the finalize counting step. Explicit counting.top_margin_px rejects null/booleans/nonintegers; either configured boundary requires a nonblank string source-inspection reason. Range is checked by line_bands. Invalid metadata remains a finalize error, not an accepted fallback. Existing fig86/87 exclusion helpers and all crop/extraction integration are untouched.
One sentence extends the existing source-inspected counting-boundary convention to the top margin; excluding any printed text remains prohibited.

focusedTestRun.expectationBasis: New synthetic fixtures have three explicitly drawn printed rows, one separately drawn interior top artifact and optionally one side artifact. Expectations and source-coordinate row intervals are specified from those constructions, not reverse-engineered from real-page counter output.
coverage: Only the explicitly declared top artifact is excluded; input ink unchanged.
Old default, explicit None API default and no-boundary page metadata remain identical.
Text beginning exactly at the boundary and a standalone printed glyph remain counted at their original coordinates.
Upper printed heading is not implicitly discarded; metadata without a source-inspection reason rejects.
Top and side boundaries work independently and compose.
Zero, negatives, above10%, booleans, floats, strings, collections and nonnative integer values reject, including empty-page input.
Lower1px bound and floor(height/10) bound accepted; next pixel rejects.
Missing/blank/nonstring reasons and explicit metadata null/boolean/noninteger values reject.
The finalize counting entry forwards both boundaries to the native line_bands API.
Source PNG bytes, image pixels and native crop bytes remain identical.
